title: Chiratidzo Chinobva Kumucheto kweGuta
intro: Muguta rakasiya kutungamirirwa naMwari, munhu mumwe chete akabuda kunze kwenyika, achimhanya neshoko retariro nenyevero. Mweya uyu wakanganikwa waizova chiratidzo chisingaperi chekutenda kwakasimba.
clues: Ndakaona nhume dzichitumwa kuguta rangu, asi vanhu vangu vakavaramba sevanhuwo zvavo.
Ndakatenda mumashoko avo uye ndakanzwa chokwadi chichindibata-bata.
Ndakakurudzira vanhu vangu kuti vateerere nhume dzisina kukumbira mubairo.
Ndakamhanya kubva kumagumo eguta, ndichiedza nekukurumidza kuti vaone chikonzero.
Vanhu vangu vakandimukira, ndikaurayiwa, asi ndakawana rugare rusingaperi.
Allah akati kwandiri, 'Pinda muParadhiso,' uye ndaishuvira kuti vanhu vangu vaone rukudzo rwandakapihwa.
